resultPolicy.readmeResults: Benchmark JSON files under results/ are rendered into README.md and docs/results.html after the local one-command run.
resultPolicy.localResults: Scratch and personal reruns can be saved under gitignored local_results/.

targets.webJs: Flutter Web release build in Chrome through the JavaScript renderer output.
targets.webWasm: Flutter Web Wasm release build in Chrome through the same browser scraper.
targets.native: Flutter integration_test benchmark on the selected native device, windows by default on this checkout.
